setup-pstack.en: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget, for this project only. Detects the models pi can run with their prices, maps roles by cost rules (no named presets), and writes .pi/pstack-models.md, which the pstack extension injects into every prompt. Use for /skill:setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.
setup-pstack.zh: 只为当前项目配置 pstack 各角色的模型和推理预算。检测 pi 能跑的模型及价格，按成本规则给出映射，写入 .pi/pstack-models.md，由 pstack 扩展注入每条提示。用于 /setup-pstack、"configure pstack models"、"pstack budget"，或要改 pstack 模型选择时。
